correctness.rationale: A fixed trace fixes the parity on each disjoint cyclic edge gap; a switch-edge subset and one bit determine the whole word. Thus the binomial gap coefficient counts exactly, including singleton and empty supports. The allowable totals fill a step-two interval. Its lower endpoint has maximum 2 floor(s/2); its upper endpoint has minimum 2 ceil((n-s)/2), because the allowed gap-difference vectors have even parity. These separate extrema suffice for a universal trace condition and give the asserted rank with even k. Lexicographic shelling and the reduced Euler characteristic give the stated wedge, including r=1. The online upper bound counts distinct leaves, while the fixed-initial-bit subclass with one switch per block permits median splitting independently in each block. The size bound gives equality at n=3,4 with k=2; all 16 supplied n=5 certificate paths lead to distinct consistent two-switch words. A new bitmask check verified 2,208 support/class instances covering all traces for n=3..8, and every certificate path; replay: /workspace/branches/replay-cyclic.py. The all-n claims rest on the proof, not this finite check.
